headline: A crucial punt exchange
what_happened: The Colts decided to punt, which is kicking the ball away on their fourth and final try to give the Chiefs possession instead of risking a gamble.
who: R.Sanchez kicked the ball and N.Remigio returned it.
why_it_matters: This is good news for the Chiefs as the Colts' chances of winning dropped significantly, keeping the game tied at 27-27.
